unit: Counts are distinct fixtures targeted at one registered detector family. A twin pair is an authored positive plus its negative twin (2 fixtures); a positive/context case is a secret-bearing fixture with no twin; an non-twin benign control is a non-secret, non-twin fixture. Total fixtures = positive cases + benign controls + 2 x twin pairs + any unclassified remainder, and no cell may be met by surplus in another.

axes.positiveContext: Distinct authored context groups (the fixture `group`) among the family's secret-bearing fixtures, twin-paired positives included.
axes.control: Distinct reviewed benign taxonomy axes among non-twin benign controls. The unscored `pending` axis never counts.
axes.confusion: Distinct benign taxonomy axes plus distinct twin mutation kinds: every way the corpus confuses the value with a non-secret.

arrival-provisional.title: Arrival / provisional
arrival-provisional.enforcementRationale: Measured 2026-09-24 before any status changed: most registered families miss at least one arrival cell, so gating provisional on it would demote families with a working detector. The debt is published per family; #207 and #209 raise it, and this flips to enforced once they land.
arrival-provisional.rationale: The smallest structure in which no evidence cell is empty: total count alone cannot hide a family with twins but no non-twin benign control, or the reverse.

stable-documented.title: Stable / documented
stable-documented.enforcementRationale: Measured 2026-09-24 before any status changed: most families that read stable under status-criteria.json miss arrival cells (see docs/generated/fixture-profile-coverage.md). Enforcing now would demote them with no detector regression, which the beta.8 epic (#114) forbids. A family that explicitly claims this profile in its contract is enforced regardless.
stable-documented.rationale: The arrival structure plus every existing stable gate in status-criteria.json and a T1 provider-documented contract.

stable-empirical.title: Stable / empirical
stable-empirical.enforcementRationale: Nothing is claimed yet. Any family that claims it is checked against every cell.

gates.rationale: The observation and corroboration gates belong to #177 and #205. Until the classifier enforces them a claim of this profile can never reach stable, so it fails closed.

stable-empirical.rationale: For providers that publish no token grammar: T2 evidence stays T2, and the fixture structure is larger than the documented profile because the contract is inferred rather than read.

context-constrained-empirical.title: Context-constrained empirical
context-constrained-empirical.enforcementRationale: Nothing is claimed yet. Any family that claims it is checked against every cell.

cellNotes.positiveCases: Structural non-emptiness only; the issue sets no positive count for this profile.
cellNotes.benignControls: Structural non-emptiness only; the issue sets no control count for this profile.
cellNotes.twinPairs: Context-twin pairs: the same value with and without the supported context.

gates.rationale: The observation and corroboration gates belong to #177 and #205. Until the classifier enforces them a claim of this profile can never reach stable, so it fails closed.

context-constrained-empirical.rationale: For opaque values whose shape is not independently discriminative: the family makes no bare-value support claim, and the contract names the context it does support.
